free_parameters.name: q_len
free_parameters.why: query length; the target only inspects q.shape[0] (batch) and both tests use the same value; q_len=1 routes the negative run through the simple flash path

free_parameters.name: num_q_heads
free_parameters.why: head count is not part of the witness; the batch-size assert does not read it

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: kv head count is not part of the witness; the assert does not read it

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: smallest head_dim accepted by the function (assert head_dim in {16,32,64,128}), keeps CPU stand-in cheap

free_parameters.name: gamma
free_parameters.why: required positional attention coverage ratio; unused before the target assert

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU test uses float32; the assert only reads tensor shapes, not dtype

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed torch seed for deterministic tensor construction

mocks.reason: GPU-only flash attention is reached only in the negative (batch_size=1) run, after the target assert has passed. The repository binds flash_attn_func = triton_flash_attention when flash-attn is unavailable, so patching the module global replaces only that kernel launcher.
